proof_body:
by
  intro 𝕜 _ H _ _ _ U
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
    refine ⟨fun y => ⟨ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint U y, congrArg (fun F => F y) h2⟩, U.norm_map_iff_adjoint_comp_self.mpr h1⟩
  · rintro ⟨hs, hn⟩
    have h1 := U.norm_map_iff_adjoint_comp_self.mp hn
    refine ⟨h1, ?_⟩
    ext y
    obtain ⟨x, rfl⟩ := hs y
    have := congrArg (fun F => F x) h1
    exact congrArg U this
target_source: ∀ (𝕜 : Type*) [RCLike 𝕜] (H : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup H] [InnerProductSpace 𝕜 H] [CompleteSpace H] (U : H →L[𝕜] H), ((ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint U).comp U = ContinuousLinearMap.id 𝕜 H ∧ U.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint U) = ContinuousLinearMap.id 𝕜 H) ↔ (Function.Surjective U ∧ ∀ x, ‖U x‖ = ‖x‖)
